title: Custom Chat System
description: A web application that allows users to send and receive message real-time includes live-notifications, authentication, and even private messaging.
details:
• Live-Messaging: Real-time communication with WebSocket protocol for instant message delivery.
  • Live-Notification: Real-time alerts for chat statuses and message updates, enhancing user engagement and responsiveness.
  • Login and Registration: Secure user authentication with encryption layer.
  • Private Messaging: Direct one-on-one chat which auto-deletes after session ends for privacy and security.

title: Hold On
description: Mini-game that eats your time holding on that button. Must be played with your significant others. Hold until you last to be not last!
details:
• Real-time Live Connectivity: With WebSockets powerful protocol, players can now interact with each other at the same time.
  • Simple Color Design: Minimalistic and common color palette for clean and direct visuals.
  • Dark Mode: Dynamic environment based on your system preference.
  • Interactive and Responsive: Dynamic elements to drive user engagements upon looking at the screen on any screen-sizes.

title: NPTA Website
description: A website that helps an association for spreading their advocacies and reactions especially school matters with regards to teachers, students, and parents' relationship.
details:
• Advocacy Hub: Dedicated digital channels for publishing community insights and school-related circulars.
  • Responsive Design: Fully responsive interface written with modern SASS workflows for crisp cross-device reading.
  • Interactive Layouts: Dynamic JavaScript elements to drive seamless user engagements and media browsing.

title: Waterwise Application
description: A water business desktop application that operates basic CRUD and prints informative and useful documents for everyday tasks.
details:
• Data Management: Streamlined CRUD operations to smoothly handle consumer accounts and usage profiles.
  • Document Generation: Instant printing setups for professional invoices, summary logs, and statements.
  • Relational Storage: Scalable SQL architecture ensuring quick queries and optimized data integrity.
